warranty.notes: 70% of usable energy at 10 years or the Minimum Through Output Energy, whichever comes first. 3.65 MWh per usable kWh: 11.68 MWh per 3.2 kWh module (LX F6.4-H-20 23.36 MWh to LX F28.8-H-20 105.12 MWh).
